nodes.description: DelegationStorage.implementation: address used as the delegatecall target for all delegator calls; mutable by admin via _setImplementation.
ActivityBase.admin: privileged address checked by checkAdmin for all admin-gated configuration functions.
ActivityBase.marketingFund: destination address for the marketing portion of dividend fees.
ActivityBase.developerDAOFund: destination address for the developer/DAO portion of dividend fees.
ActivityBase.startBlock: mining start block used as the anchor of reward calculations.
ShardingDAOMining.poolInfo: private array of PoolInfo structs holding per-pool LP amount, weights, dividend accumulators and oracle state.
ShardingDAOMining.userInfo: mapping pid => user => UserInfo with amount, originWeight, inviteeWeight, endBlock and isCalculateInvitation.
ShardingDAOMining.usersRelationshipInfo: invitation graph (invitor, invitees, index map, used/withdrawn flags).
ShardingDAOMining.rankPoolIndex: dynamic array of pool ids that currently participate in the ranking/dividend set.
ActivityBase.isUserContractSender: mapping pid => address => bool flagging senders that are contracts rather than EOAs.
ActivityBase.poolTokenAmountLimit: mapping pid => deposit amount threshold above which an extra fee rate applies.
ShardingDAOMining.shardMintWeight: numerator weight used to split freshly minted SHD between farming and reserve.
ShardingDAOMining.lastRewardBlock: last block for which rewards have been minted; updated by mintSHARD.
SHDToken.minters: mapping address => bool of accounts allowed to call mint.
ShardingDAOMiningDelegator._setImplementation: admin-only function that overwrites the implementation address and optionally resigns/becomes implementation.
ShardingDAOMiningDelegator.delegateTo: performs a raw callee.delegatecall(data) and bubbles up revert data via assembly.
ShardingDAOMiningDelegator.delegateToImplementation: public entry that delegates arbitrary data to the current implementation address.
ShardingDAOMiningDelegator.fallback: payable fallback that delegatecalls msg.data to the implementation address, forwarding returndata or reverting.
ActivityBase.checkAdmin: internal guard requiring admin == msg.sender before privileged state changes.
ActivityBase.transferAdmin: reassigns the admin address after the checkAdmin guard.
ActivityBase.calculateDividend: splits a pending dividend into marketing, dev and user parts using fee-rate numerators/denominators.
ActivityBase.judgeContractSender: marks msg.sender as a contract sender when msg.sender != tx.origin, which is spoofable by tx.origin relayers.
ShardingDAOMining.initialize: one-time owner-only setup called through the delegator's constructor delegatecall.
ShardingDAOMining.deposit: accepts LP tokens, computes lock-time weights, updates invitation weights and pulls tokens via safeTransferFrom.
ShardingDAOMining.withdraw: mints rewards, computes and pays out dividends, then clears user weight state and returns LP tokens.
ShardingDAOMining.mintSHARD: mints new SHD to this contract and accumulates a reserve amount based on mint weights.
ShardingDAOMining.add: registers a new Uniswap LP pool; caller must be the nftShard contract or the admin.
ShardingDAOMining.acceptInvitation: links the caller into an existing invitor's invitation tree.
ShardingDAOMining.tryToReplacePoolInRank: permissionless rank-replacement using oracle weight comparison to swap a pool out of rank.
ShardingDAOMining.massUpdatePools: mints pending rewards and refreshes accumulative dividends for every ranked pool.
ShardingDAOMining.updateTokenOracle: reads cumulative Uniswap prices and derives a time-weighted price using block timestamps.
ShardingDAOMining.safeSHARDTransfer: internal helper that caps the transfer amount to the contract's SHD balance and performs an external transfer.
SHDToken.mint: permissioned token mint gated by minters[msg.sender].
SHDToken.addMiner: owner-only function that grants mint privileges.
ShardingDAOMining.kickEvilPoolByPid: owner-only blacklisting that also removes the pool from the rank array and redistributes its dividend.
ShardingDAOMining.getRewardToken: computes emission between two blocks from the halving schedule anchored at startBlock.
ShardingDAOMining.setNftShard: admin-gated setter for the pool-registering nftShard address.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller identity used for authorization, accounting and contract-sender classification.
tx.origin: original transaction signer used in judgeContractSender to detect contract senders; spoofable by malicious relayers.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source used by the Uniswap cumulative price oracle.
Unsafe operation: implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) in the payable fallback executes arbitrary attacker-supplied calldata under this contract's storage.
Unsafe operation: callee.delegatecall(data) inside delegateTo, transferring control and storage context to an arbitrary external address.
Unsafe operation: public wrapper functions that forward ABI-encoded calls to delegateToImplementation, exposing raw delegatecall surface to any caller.
Unsafe operation: SHD.mint(address,uint256) token creation invoked from mintSHARD; mint amount derives from block math.
Unsafe operation: external ERC20/IERC20 safeTransfer and safeTransferFrom calls to LP tokens, SHD and fund addresses.
Unsafe operation: staticcall/contract call into an external Uniswap pair whose reserves and prices are untrusted, plus staticcall-based view delegation.
deposit parameter _amount: LP token amount supplied by the user, used for transfer-in and weight computation.
deposit local newOriginWeight: recomputed lock-time weight combining existing and new deposits.
withdraw parameter _pid: index selecting which pool's UserInfo and PoolInfo are manipulated.
withdraw local pending: user dividend share, reduced by fees before being transferred out.
add parameter _nftPoolId: identifier of the NFT shard pool being registered in poolInfo.
pool dividend local poolReward: per-pool emission share computed and split across ranked pools.

edges.reason: checkAdmin compares the admin state variable with msg.sender, so caller identity decides whether privileged functions proceed.
_setImplementation is publicly callable and relies on checkAdmin(msg.sender) to restrict who may replace the implementation.
transferAdmin derives the new owner from an admin-only caller authority.
checkAdmin reads the admin state variable to authorize the caller.
admin state is the authoritative value verified by checkAdmin before any privileged write.
transferAdmin writes the admin state variable, changing who passes future checkAdmin guards.
_setImplementation overwrites implementation, the target of every delegatecall; admin control of this var is the whole trust model.
delegateToImplementation uses the implementation state variable as the delegatecall destination.
delegateToImplementation forwards to delegateTo with the current implementation address.
callee.delegatecall executes untrusted implementation code that can re-enter the delegator and mutate its storage.
The fallback delegatecalls msg.data to the implementation address, so attacker calldata runs in this contract's context.
The payable fallback forwards arbitrary msg.data to the implementation, giving any caller raw delegatecall reach.
Any external caller with unmatched calldata reaches the fallback entry point.
Public wrapper functions forward ABI-encoded calls into delegateTo, exposing raw delegatecall to any caller.
deposit keys UserInfo and invitation state on the caller-supplied msg.sender.
withdraw resolves the UserInfo entry and payout recipient from msg.sender.
deposit requires and reads the sender's invitation record before updating weights.
deposit writes amount, originWeight and endBlock into userInfo.
deposit reads and mutates the PoolInfo entry for the supplied pid (LP amount, oracle weight, lastDividendHeight).
deposit calls judgeContractSender to classify the caller as an EOA or a contract for fee purposes.
judgeContractSender reads msg.sender to decide whether the caller is a contract sender.
The msg.sender != tx.origin heuristic is spoofable by a relayer that controls tx.origin, bypassing or forcing fee classification.
judgeContractSender permanently flags isUserContractSender[pid][msg.sender], which later raises fees in calculateDividend.
withdraw passes the computed pending share into calculateDividend, which performs mul/div fee splits with configurable rates.
withdraw transfers dividends to marketingFund, developerDAOFund and msg.sender before resetting user.amount, originWeight and endBlock, violating checks-effects-interactions.
safeSHARDTransfer performs an external SHD transfer whose recipient can re-enter withdraw while user state is still set.
withdraw triggers mintSHARD before computing payouts, so reward accounting and payout amounts are coupled.
mintSHARD invokes the privileged SHD.mint, so reward computation directly controls token issuance.
mintSHARD reads lastRewardBlock as the start of the reward interval and advances it to the current block.
The farm/reserve split divides totalReward by (reserveMintWeight + shardMintWeight); zero weights or unchecked division affect minted amounts.
mintSHARD derives the minted amount from getRewardToken over the elapsed block range, using a halving loop with many divisions.
The emission schedule is anchored at startBlock, and setStartBlock rewrites lastRewardBlock accordingly.
massUpdatePools mints pending rewards and then distributes them, so any mint math error propagates to all pool dividend accumulators.
massUpdatePools iterates the rankPoolIndex array to update each ranked pool's accumulative dividend.
add requires msg.sender == nftShard || msg.sender == admin, an authorization check on caller identity.
add pushes a new PoolInfo struct into poolInfo and derives the new pool id from its length.
updateTokenOracle derives prices from block.timestamp deltas and Uniswap cumulative values, making valuation miner-influenceable.
updateTokenOracle queries an untrusted external Uniswap pair for reserves and cumulative prices.
tryToReplacePoolInRank rewrites rankPoolIndex and rankPoolIndexMap entries based on oracle weight comparison.
kickEvilPoolByPid removes the pool from rankPoolIndex by swapping with the last element and popping.
tryToReplacePoolInRank reads pool lpTokenAmount and oracle weights from poolInfo before swapping rank membership.
acceptInvitation builds the invitation edge using the caller's msg.sender as the invitee.
acceptInvitation writes invitor, invitees and index map entries into usersRelationshipInfo.
SHDToken.mint requires minters[msg.sender] == true, an access-control gate on the caller.
mint reads the minters mapping to authorize token creation.
addMiner writes the minters mapping to grant minting privileges.
setNftShard calls checkAdmin before changing the address allowed to register pools.
calculateDividend applies the pool deposit-limit fee rate when the user amount reaches poolTokenAmountLimit, altering payout proportions.
The user-supplied _amount is added to LP amounts and multiplied into deposit weights.
newOriginWeight is computed from lock-time weight arrays and amounts and then written into userInfo.
The _pid parameter selects which PoolInfo/UserInfo entries withdraw reads and clears.
The pending dividend share is reduced by fees and then used as the external transfer amount.
_nftPoolId is stored in the new PoolInfo when registering a pool via add.
Per-pool reward shares are produced by division across ranked pools and added to accumulativeDividend.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is only meaningful inside deposit where it feeds the LP transfer and weight computation.
newOriginWeight is a temporary accumulator for deposit weight and is written straight into userInfo.
_pid is only used inside withdraw to index poolInfo and userInfo.
pending is the intermediate dividend value that is split and transferred out during withdraw.
_nftPoolId is consumed only by add when constructing the new PoolInfo entry.
poolReward is the intermediate per-pool emission share produced while massUpdatePools refreshes dividend accumulators.
